findings.summary: Finished incoming review indefinitely holds live updates

findings.action: Released current incoming live holds after closed/applied/rejected states and removed the parent retained-object hold.

findings.summary: Incoming Apply leaves health reports stale

findings.action: Refreshed all three health prefixes after Apply or recovered applied readback; active consumers show updated data.

findings.summary: Different shared Release metadata writes can silently last-win
findings.evidence: Public CreateGitHubLink(releaseId) and copied canonical refs can have no Release remote link. Then two pulls emit differing Release updates without duplicate baseline sets; initialVersions permits both. Extend existing divergence detection using its existing owning-map conflict contract and cover the source-only-ref sequence.
findings.action: Extended divergence checks to Release updates using existing owning-map fingerprints; a public source-only canonical ref rejects differing metadata atomically.
findings.repair_verification: passed in focused and final full workspace gates

findings.summary: Sibling incoming decisions overlap Card-owned actions
findings.evidence: Mutation keys count writes but do not exclude them; each review checks only its own pending ref. Check shared counts synchronously, reflect busy controls, retain draft/navigation safety, and remove only Incoming review boolean aggregation.
findings.action: Added synchronous shared-count guards and reactive controls; sibling same-event decisions, linked pull and Save cannot overlap; dependency callback/drafts/navigation remain intact.
findings.repair_verification: passed in focused and final full workspace gates

findings.summary: Import results repeatedly read and scan every canonical ref
findings.evidence: The item callback calls listExternalRefsForStoryMap and searches proposed refs for every source row. Build proposed/linked lookup maps once without changing outcomes or IDs.
findings.action: Built proposed/linked identity maps once per callback without per-row repository reads.
